g.text: John Oliver Issues Urgent Warning Ahead of Midterms About the Republican Party’s Nazi Ties ◆ Peggy King, ‘George Gobel Show’ Actress and Singer of the ’50s, Dies at 96 ◆ Holland Taylor Says She Was ‘Never Paid Very Well’ on ‘Two and a Half Men’: ‘I Got Four Emmy Nominations, and They Never Gave Me a Raise’ ◆ Jessica Biel Says ‘7th Heaven’ Reboot Will ‘Modernize’ the Show Now That TV Has ‘Less Limitations’: ‘We Were Very Careful About What Our Audience Wanted’ ◆ ‘The New Stanford Prison Experiment’ Creators Break Down Its Shocking Finale ◆ ESPN Taps Marvel’s Vision to Boost ElClásico’s Debut on ABC ◆
